detail.quote: Since Theresa tests J, and Yuki tests H, Reynaldo must test G.  So, Reynaldo tests G on the second day. This is possible.
detail.explanation: The reasoning mixes up days: if Yuki tests H on the first day, the first-day assignment forces Reynaldo to test G on the first day, not the second. In fact, option A cannot occur: Theresa must test H on day two, and Reynaldo testing G that day leaves Seamus and Yuki to test F and J. But Seamus must test on day two the bicycle Yuki tested on day one; Yuki cannot test J, so this arrangement cannot work.
